page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-96 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the c4d server family. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance is configured with 372.0 GB of system memory, which yields a memory-to-core ratio of 3.88 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high core count and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, the c4d-standard-96 offers resource density suitable for multi-threaded workloads. It is positioned for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, and distributed compute tasks that require dedicated CPU allocation without the need for local NVMe storage or hardware acceleration.
